alerts.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued November 9 at 2:58PM PST until November 10 at 12:00PM PST by NWS San Diego CA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Minor to locally moderate coastal flooding expected.

* WHERE...Orange County Coastal Areas.

* WHEN...Until noon PST Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of parking lots and roads with only
isolated road closures expected.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...High tide Tuesday morning is expected to
peak over 7 feet MLLW, which is 1.2 to 1.4 feet above
astronomical tide predictions. Higher surf today could prolong
coastal impacts.
